newFact: Local pack_evidence.js rejects both C4 fixtures without git, network, or Grexal. malicious-paths.patch (194B, two files) fails check no-unsafe-paths: unsafePaths=["../../etc/passwd"] from `diff --git a/../../etc/passwd b/../../etc/passwd` (plus the matching ---/+++ headers); structuralChecksPass=false; CLI exit 2. oversized.patch (2000183B, one file huge.txt) with --maxDiffBytes 100000 fails check diff-size-limit (detail bytes=2000183 max=100000, exceedsMaxBytes=true); structuralChecksPass=false; CLI exit 2. Default DEFAULT_MAX_DIFF_BYTES=5242880 still accepts the 2MiB fixture — the size-limit failure is the 100000-byte cap, not the 5MiB default. Pre-patch, quoted `diff --git "a/../../etc/passwd"`, +++-only traversal with a safe git header, backslash `..\..\etc\passwd`, and unprefixed `diff --git ../../etc/passwd` were accepted (structuralChecksPass=true, unsafePaths=[]). Analyzer now parses quoted git tokens, ---/+++ and rename/copy headers before the first hunk, normalizes backslash to slash, unique-ifies unsafePaths, and treats /dev/null as not unsafe. Tests added for the 100000-byte cap and those encodings. gitApplyVerified=false; grexalPaidExecution=false; paidModelCalls=0; buyerAcceptanceVerified=false. Local packager run is not a Grexal paid execution, git-apply proof, or buyer escrow acceptance.
